heldOutBasis: The pinned repository is absent from analyzer development fixtures, resolver tests, pinned regression labels, and evaluator inputs. A compatibility scan was generated during this audit before finalizing this source-authored candidate package; no resolver changes were made from its output and no candidate predictions are used as truth. This establishes only resolver-development separation, not independent annotation.
annotationNote: Candidate relationships were checked against pinned source. The author had access to compatibility scan output, so these labels are not independent. A separate blinded reviewer must approve or correct every relationship before accuracy analysis.

suitability.evidence: The pinned package declares NestJS 9, Jest 27, and TypeScript 4.9 development dependencies, with Jest configured for src TypeScript tests. AuthService and AuthController contain decorated production methods with matching Jest declarations.
limitations: This is one small public application and does not establish generalization to other NestJS repositories.
Candidate labels are not independently reviewed and must not be used as accuracy results.
Static Jest declarations do not establish that tests ran or passed.
The task cases are in one authentication subsystem; independent reviewers must assess difficulty matching before participant recruitment.
A password-like test fixture is correctly secret-redacted in persisted evidence; reviewers must confirm the task remains answerable from the available evidence.

testIdentity.title: should return user info without password when validate successful

sourceSupport.purpose: direct method invocation and returned user assertions
user lookup, password comparison, and password omission

mockBoundary.detail: UserService.findUser is a Jest spy returning a test-controlled user record.

annotations.rationale: The test body invokes validateUser and asserts properties of the returned value; no execution result is claimed.

testIdentity.title: should throw bad request exception when invalid user

sourceSupport.purpose: direct async invocation and rejection assertion
missing-user exception branch

mockBoundary.detail: UserService.findUser is stubbed to resolve undefined.

annotations.rationale: The declaration directly invokes validateUser with a test-controlled missing-user result and declares a rejection assertion.

testIdentity.title: should throw bad request exception when invalid password

sourceSupport.purpose: direct async invocation with controlled user and rejection assertion
password mismatch branch

mockBoundary.detail: UserService.findUser is stubbed to return a test-controlled user password.

annotations.rationale: The test declaration supplies a user record and invokes validateUser with a different password.

testIdentity.title: should return user profile when login successful

sourceSupport.purpose: direct invocation and returned profile assertions
validation call, token generation, and returned auth data

mockBoundary.detail: validateUser and generateToken are both spied and return test-controlled values.

annotations.rationale: The test invokes login but stubs its validation and token-generation methods, so it does not establish their implementations.

testIdentity.title: should call login service when call login controller

sourceSupport.purpose: direct controller invocation and response assertions
service call and response wrapping

mockBoundary.detail: AuthService.login is stubbed to resolve a fixed profile.

annotations.rationale: The test invokes AuthController.login directly; the service behavior is supplied by a spy.

testIdentity.title: should call login service when call login controller

sourceSupport.purpose: controller statically calls AuthService.login
the test replaces AuthService.login with a resolving spy
service method identity

mockBoundary.detail: AuthService.login is mocked; the test does not execute this service implementation through the controller call.

annotations.rationale: A production static call path exists from controller to service, but this declaration mocks the called method; static reachability must not be reported as observed execution.

testIdentity.title: should throw error when email is exist

sourceSupport.purpose: direct registration invocation with an asserted duplicate-email exception
duplicate username/email checks and subsequent create/token calls

mockBoundary.detail: UserService.findUser is stubbed to return undefined once and then a matching email record.

annotations.rationale: The declaration checks the exception path; it does not assert that createUser or generateToken was not called.

sourceSupport.purpose: testing module provides a JwtService mock whose sign method returns token
direct invocation and equality assertion
delegation to JwtService.sign

mockBoundary.detail: JwtService.sign is configured as a Jest mock returning the literal token.

annotations.rationale: The source and declaration support returning the mocked sign result, not that the test executes or that the result is a valid signed JWT.

sourceSupport.purpose: controller existence assertion with no login invocation
target method identity

mockBoundary.detail: The module creates a controller and test providers, but the selected declaration does not invoke login.

annotations.rationale: Candidate negative pair: the declaration asserts that the controller object exists and contains no supported reference to login.
